data.narrative:
Isar Aerospace, a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $650M+ to date, is valued herein against a universe of 6 private and 5 public comparable companies in the Space & Aerospace sector. The private peer set spans adjacent stages (Series B through Series D) and includes Sierra Space, Apex Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, and Aalyria.

Two valuation methods yield applicable results. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $650M total raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, implying a $1.1B valuation. Peer-median triangulation across the 6 same-sector comparables yields a $1.8B implied value, with the peer set ranging from $1.15B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 27.4x across five tickers: RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) is inapplicable due to absence of disclosed revenue for the private target.

Triangulating the two applicable methods produces a low of $939M, median of $1.4B, and high of $2.1B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around which peer cohort most closely tracks Isar's development trajectory and capital efficiency. Stage-progression conservatism and peer-median elevation diverge notably; resolution requires clarity on Isar's near-term milestones, burn profile, and competitive positioning within the crowded launch-services subsector.
